name: Omarchy Multiroom Speakers
author: Sven Wagener
description: Play this computer's sound on AirPlay speakers such as HomePods, Sonos and Apple TV, in one room or in several at once. Direct mode uses PipeWire's own AirPlay; multiroom mode plays through OwnTone in sync like a Mac or iPhone, including Chromecast speakers.

barWidget.description: Click to pick the mode and the rooms that play this computer's sound.

schema.label: Show rooms in the bar
schema.description: Show the number of playing rooms next to the icon.

schema.label: OwnTone program
schema.description: Optional. Full path to the owntone binary. Empty: the build from tools/build-owntone.sh, else /usr/bin/owntone.
